title: Enemy attachments: perimeter
requestedFormat: Single isolated asset, transparent background, square canvas, entire silhouette inside safe margins, no floor or cast background shadow
prompt:
Create artwork for a narrative incremental bunker-defense game. Weathered industrial electrical science fiction; painterly, grounded game illustration with crisp readable silhouettes. Charcoal steel, dirty concrete, aged copper, pale cyan electricity, warm amber shelter lights. Restrained detail at small display sizes. Shared engineering signature: asymmetrical copper winding, three ceramic insulators, hand-cut fastening plate with a clipped upper-right corner. No logos, watermarks, captions, or readable text; evidence text and UI labels will be added separately.

Attach approved style, subject, and location reference images when available. Preserve their identity, proportions, materials, and engineering details exactly. If no reference is attached, use the written working design consistently. Generate one image for this request.

REQUEST: Separated interchangeable sector dressing for enemies: corrosion and torn fence wire. Match approved enemy scale; attachment kit, not a new enemy.

COMPOSITION AND OUTPUT: Single isolated asset, transparent background, square canvas, entire silhouette inside safe margins, no floor or cast background shadow.

REFERENCE INPUTS: Approved enemy images.

PRODUCTION PASS: Use case: stylized-concept. Attached images are provisional production references from this batch, not claims of human approval. Image 1: scrap-walker-idle, reference for its subject and materials. Image 2: steel-sentinel-idle, reference for its subject and materials. Image 3: iron-colossus-idle, reference for its subject and materials. Image 4: engineering-reference, reference for its subject and materials. Use the established machine geometry. For attachment kits separate the small parts clearly with generous gaps; no complete new robot. Internals must visibly show the same three insulators and clipped plate. Generate the one requested image, no reference-sheet collage unless this request explicitly asks for a kit or reference sheet.
review: Candidate for visual review and target-size readability checks.
